title: Fear-Touched Dracolich ambush
summary: Qualifying kills can trigger a Fear-Touched Dracolich ambush.
overview: Qualifying kills can trigger a Fear-Touched Dracolich ambush.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: During the associated active task, keep the group ready after each kill.
The ambush can appear at the slain enemy's location and immediately attack the credited player.
A tank should collect the dracolich before the group moves on.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
The reviewed source is standard or unversioned; this draft applies to version 0.
The loader is gated by the Rotten_Hand content flag; the spawn check requires task 17 and rolls a three-percent chance.
